tool.name: sincei scBulkCoverage
tool.description: pseudo-bulk coverage tracks per group of cells

param.label: Group info
param.help: A 4-column table with cell grouping information in the format sample::barcode, UMAP1, UMAP2, group (like the output from scClusterCells), or a 3-column table with format sample, barcode, group. Coverages will be computed per group. The first line is always read as a header line and must not start with #. Samples must match the BAM dataset names without .bam.

param.label: Normalize using
param.help: How to normalize the pseudo-bulk counts.
param.option: CPM: normalize each bin to the counts per million mapped reads in that group
Frequency: binarize the coverage per bin and normalize to the total no. of cells per group
Mean: mean signal per bin across cells in each group
None: simply return the sum of coverage per group

param.label: Ignore for normalization
param.help: Chromosome names to skip while calculating normalization factors. Separate multiple chromosomes with commas, e.g. chrX,chrM.

param.label: Scale factor
param.help: The computed scaling factor (or 1, if not applicable) will be multiplied by this.

param.label: MNase
param.help: Determine nucleosome positions from MNase-seq/CUT&RUN data. Only 3 nucleotides at the center of each fragment are counted. The fragment ends are defined by the two mate reads. Only fragment lengths between 130 - 200 bp are considered to avoid dinucleosomes or other artifacts, unless the minimum/maximum fragment length filters are set. NOTE: Requires paired-end data. A bin size of 1 is recommended.

param.label: Offset
param.help: Uses this offset inside of each read as the signal. This is useful in cases like RiboSeq or GROseq, where the signal is 12, 15 or 0 bases past the start of the read. Negative values indicate offsets from the end of each read. A value of 1 indicates the first base of the alignment (taking alignment orientation into account), -1 is the last base of the alignment. An offset of 0 is not permitted. If two space-separated values are specified, they define a range of positions, e.g. '5 -1' uses the 5th through last position. If reads are centered, the centering is performed before the offset.

validator.message: One or two non-zero integers separated by a space

tool.help:
**What it does**
`scBulkCoverage` aggregates the reads of cells that belong to the same group (e.g. a cluster from `scClusterCells`, or a batch) and writes one pseudo-bulk coverage track per group. Coverage is counted in bins and can be normalized per group. The tracks can be viewed in a genome browser or used with deepTools.
-----
**Inputs**
- One or more BAM files with a cell barcode tag. - A table assigning cells to groups, in one of two forms: - the UMAP/cluster table from `scClusterCells` (`sample::barcode`, UMAP1, UMAP2, cluster) - a 3-column table: sample, barcode, group
Both tables must start with a header line. The first line is always read as the header, so a table without one loses its first cell. Lines starting with `#` are ignored, so the header must not start with `#`. The sample names must match the BAM dataset names without the `.bam` extension.
**Outputs**
- A collection with one bigWig or bedGraph track per group. @HELP_FOOTER@
